sql.description: One PostgreSQL read query (SELECT, VALUES or TABLE). Physical tables and views must use schema-qualified names within saved application scope; system schemas, writes and session commands are excluded.

parameters.description: Ordered JSON values bound separately to $1, $2, etc. PostgreSQL infers types; use SQL casts when needed. Null means SQL NULL. Objects/arrays become JSON text; PostgreSQL array inputs use array-text strings with casts.
